class.name: IfcFlowController
class.brief_description: The distribution flow element IfcFlowController defines the occurrence of elements of a distribution system that are used to regulate flow through a distribution system. Examples include dampers, valves, switches, and relays. Its type is defined by IfcFlowControllerType or subtypes. HISTORY: New entity in IFC R2.0. IFC 2x4 NOTE: This entity has been deprecated for instantiation and will become ABS
